dialogs.about: 거실에서 할아버지과 텔레비전 볼 것 정하기

lines.en: Come sit on the sofa. Let's watch television.
What do you want to watch tonight?
The old song show. I watched it last week.
I want to watch the news first.
Okay. The news is short. Turn on the lamp.
Can you close the window? It's cold.
Sure. Now the room is warm and comfortable.
After the news, we will watch your show.
lines.ko: 뉴스 끝나면 당신 프로그램을 볼 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. Will you make some tea?
Yes. Let's talk and drink tea together.

dialogs.about: 이웃이 놀러 와 소파에서 차 마시기

lines.en: Hello! Thank you for asking me to your home.
Welcome. Please sit on the sofa.
Your home is so comfortable. I love the lamp.
lines.ko: 집이 정말 편안해요. 램프가 마음에 들어요.

lines.en: Thank you. My husband made this table years ago.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 남편이 몇 년 전에 이 탁자를 만들었어요.

lines.en: Really? He is good with his hands.
Would you like some tea? Green or black?
Green, please. What are you watching on television?
A cooking show. Do you like to cook?
Yes. Next week I will bring you some cake.
lines.ko: 네. 다음 주에 케이크를 좀 가져올게요.

lines.en: How kind! Let's talk by the window.
